verdict.rationale: Vercel Agent is a built-in AI assistant with dashboard and Slack chat that can investigate issues and take approved actions. The official Vercel MCP server also lets approved AI clients run deployments, read logs and buy domains from natural-language prompts. Coverage is partial because the in-product chat is public beta, limited to Pro and Enterprise, and the set of operations it can perform is not enumerated. missing for 10: GA availability on all plans, documented full scope of natural-language operations inside the product, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Vercel Agent is an AI assistant built into Vercel. Use it to understand your projects, investigate production issues, review code, and take approved actions.
Chat in Slack, dashboard chat, Investigations, and Code Review are in public beta for Pro and Enterprise teams.
Connect your AI tools to Vercel using the Model Context Protocol (MCP), an open standard that lets AI assistants interact with your Vercel projects.
Each tool documents parameters and a sample prompt.
